title: Van Flandern's speed-of-gravity argument

tellings.quote: a physicist called van flandern um argues that the speed of gravity is at least two billion times the speed of light

plain: A physicist named Van Flandern argued that gravity's pull travels at least two billion times faster than light. The researcher Rupert Sheldrake passes this on as something Van Flandern argues, without naming where the argument appears. If it were true, it would break the accepted rule that nothing moves faster than light.
